title: Lue Elizondo's superiors who saw the phenomenon as demonic

tellings.quote: think in in Lou's book I found the part where he talks about some of his superiors where they had this demonic

plain: Mario Woods, a former guard at a nuclear site who says he was abducted, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about a book by Lue Elizondo, who once worked in a small Pentagon office that studied unexplained aerial reports. Woods says he found the part where Elizondo describes some of his superiors seeing the phenomenon as demonic. If true, it would mean some officials treated UFOs as a spiritual threat, not just a technical one.
